name: nssm
description: Install NSSM (Non-Sucking Service Manager) from nssm-2.24-101-g897c7ad.zip and add to PATH. The pre-release, not the 2.24 release: MAST_supervision's mast-service installer sets AppKillProcessTree to 0, which 2.24 rejects. Replaces an installed nssm.exe that differs from the archive's. See docs/decisions/2026-11-19-provisioning-vendors-the-nssm-2.24-101-pre-release.md.
